ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: In the yellow-plum season, every household has rain
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot:
First describe the image: the figure is a schematic diagram of the position of the western Pacific subtropical high ridge line. In the figure, a latitude-longitude grid, the position of the Yangtze River, and the line belt labeled “western Pacific subtropical high ridge line” can be seen; this ridge line is roughly located near 20°N—25°N, and overall is south of the “Yangtze River” label.
Then reason: the verses in the question stem are ① At Qingming time the rain falls thick and fast, ② In the yellow-plum season, every household has rain, ③ Raindrops on parasol trees make the autumn night long, ④ Gentle breeze and fine rain moisten the plum blossoms. According to the seasonal movement law of the western Pacific subtropical high, when the ridge line is located at 20°N—25°N and south of the Yangtze River, it corresponds to the possible occurrence of plum rains or yellow-plum rains in the Jianghuai region, and may also correspond to the autumn rain period; it does not correspond to Qingming spring rain, nor does it correspond to fine rain in late winter and early spring when plum blossoms bloom. Therefore, the two verses that may appear are ② and ③. Arranged from small to large according to the question-stem numbers, the 1st verse is ② “In the yellow-plum season, every household has rain.”
